mapper.insert: INSERT INTO meeting_book (user_id, room_id, start_time, end_time, purpose, participant_num, status) VALUES (#{userId}, #{roomId}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{purpose}, #{participantNum}, #{status})
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, room_id, start_time, end_time, purpose, participant_num, status, audit_msg, audit_time, create_time FROM meeting_book WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.sql: b.id AS id, b.user_id AS userId, b.room_id AS roomId, b.start_time AS startTime, b.end_time AS endTime, b.purpose AS purpose, b.participant_num AS participantNum, b.status AS status, b.audit_msg AS auditMsg, b.audit_time AS auditTime, b.create_time AS createTime, r.room_name AS roomName, r.location AS location, u.username AS username, u.real_name AS realName
mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM meeting_book b LEFT JOIN meeting_room r ON b.room_id = r.id LEFT JOIN `user` u ON b.user_id = u.id WHERE b.id = #{id}
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM meeting_book WHERE room_id = #{roomId}
